notes: LCC makes the second-clause referent explicit as 上帝<WH0430>, where UNV compresses it in 他<WH0430>.
The implicit object marker {<WAH0853>} before 男/女 in UNV is represented explicitly in LCC by 他 / 他們, so the braces are dropped there.
The first clause still has no explicit Chinese equivalent for the object marker before 人, so {<WAH0853>} is retained before 人<WH0120>.
LCC’s 有 in 有男有女 has no separate Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
